# Psalm 91 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Dweller in-shelter-of the-Most-High, in-shadow-of the-Almighty he-will-lodge.

**2** I-will-say to-YHWH, 'My-refuge and-my-fortress, my-God I-will-trust in-him.'

**3** For he will-deliver-you from-snare-of the-fowler, from-plague-of destruction.

**4** With-his-pinion he-will-cover-you, and-under his-wings you-will-find-refuge; shield and-buckler his-faithfulness.

**5** Not you-will-fear from-terror-of night, from-arrow that-flies by-day,

**6** From-plague in-darkness that-walks, from-destruction that-devastates at-noon.

**7** Will-fall at-your-side a-thousand, and-ten-thousand at-your-right-hand; to-you not it-will-approach.

**8** Only with-your-eyes you-will-look, and-recompense-of the-wicked you-will-see.

**9** For you YHWH my-refuge — the-Most-High you-have-made your-dwelling.

**10** Not will-befall to-you evil, and-plague not will-come-near in-your-tent.

**11** For his-angels he-will-command for-you, to-guard-you in-all your-ways.

**12** On-hands they-will-bear-you, lest you-strike against-a-stone your-foot.

**13** On the-lion and-the-cobra you-will-tread; you-will-trample the-young-lion and-the-serpent.

**14** 'Because in-me he-has-set-his-love, and-I-will-deliver-him; I-will-set-him-on-high because he-has-known my-name.

**15** He-will-call-on-me and-I-will-answer-him; with-him I-am in-distress; I-will-rescue-him and-I-will-honor-him.

**16** With-length-of days I-will-satisfy-him, and-I-will-show-him my-salvation.'

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **91:1**: Four divine names in vv. 1-2: Elyon ('Most-High'), Shaddai ('Almighty'), YHWH, Elohai ('my-God') — comprehensive divine protection.

- **91:11-12**: Cited by Satan in the temptation of Jesus (Matt 4:6/Luke 4:10-11) — angelic protection promises used out of context.

- **91:13**: Lion, cobra, young-lion, serpent — four dangerous creatures representing comprehensive protection from all threats.

— EMET
